The Subtask Name: Determine the nationality of the Qianlong Emperor

      description: If the Planner repeatedly sends the same request without adapting to errors, it creates a loop.
      severity: 0.7
      if_from_agent_wrong: The WebSurfer will repeatedly fail to load the same page, causing the subtask to stall.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebSurfer will encounter repeated timeouts or errors, unable to progress.
    - type: data_issue

      severity: 0.5

      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebSurfer will return incorrect or irrelevant information about the emperor's nationality.

- From_agent: WebSurfer
  To_agent: Planner
  agent_dependency_type: environment_feedback
  agent_strength: 0.85
  agent_explanation: The WebSurfer returns search results and page content (or errors) to the Planner, allowing the Planner to update its understanding of the emperor's nationality.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: If the WebSurfer misinterprets the page content or extracts incorrect metadata.
      severity: 0.6
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Planner will base its reasoning on false data, leading to an incorrect conclusion about nationality.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner may incorrectly conclude the nationality or fail to recognize the need for further verification.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: If the WebSurfer consistently fails to access any reliable source due to technical issues.
      severity: 0.8
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Planner cannot gather the necessary evidence to determine nationality.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner is forced to rely on incomplete information or make an unjustified assumption.

- From_agent: Planner
  To_agent: WebSurfer
  agent_dependency_type: loop_control
  agent_strength: 0.80
  agent_explanation: After receiving errors (timeout/Page Not Found), the Planner decides to retry with alternative URLs or search strategies, controlling the flow to avoid infinite loops of failure.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: If the Planner fails to recognize the persistent failure and keeps sending the same request.
      severity: 0.9
      if_from_agent_wrong: The system enters a loop of repeated failures without progress.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebSurfer will continue to fail, wasting resources and time.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: If the Planner decides to stop searching prematurely despite available fallback options.
      severity: 0.7
      if_from_agent_wrong: The task concludes with insufficient data.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The final answer will be based on incomplete or unverified information.

- From_agent: WebSurfer
  To_agent: Planner
  agent_dependency_type: environment_feedback
  agent_strength: 0.85
  agent_explanation: The WebSurfer reports the successful retrieval of the Britannica summary page, providing the text needed for the Planner to extract the nationality.
